'''Bogroot Focus''' is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] obtained from the [[Bogroot Chest]], which appears after defeating [[Khabuus]] ([[Giriff's War]]) or [[Z'him Monns]] ([[Tekks's War]]) in [[Bogroot Growths]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:Halves casting time of Channeling Magic [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves skill recharge of Channeling Magic spells (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Channeling Focus]] from collector [[Jahn Pitz]] or crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Channeling Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Channeling Focus]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Aptitude]]
*Perfect "[[Inscription#Forget Me Not|Forget Me Not]]" inscription

==Unique counterpart==
The [[Channeling Magic]] version of [[Droknar's Focus]] has stats identical to this item.
